detail: Reproduce msf-CNN (arXiv 2505.11483) claim: MBV2-w0.35, P1, F=Inf gives minimal peak RAM 8.56 kB. Command from RECLAIM mre_config: python analysis_optimization.py -m MBV2-w0.35 -p P1 -c1 inf

Entry point and analysis/ only import numpy and the standard library. requirements.txt pins numpy==1.24.4, which has wheels for CPython 3.8-3.11 only, so try the newest Python first to see if the pin breaks.
python:3.12-slim, install requirements.txt as given, run the paper's command.

detail: numpy==1.24.4 has no CPython 3.12 wheel, so pip falls back to the sdist, whose setup.py build backend fails under Python 3.12 (exit code 2 in get_requires_for_build_wheel). Keep the authors' pin and use a Python version numpy 1.24.4 supports instead of changing the dependency.
Dockerfile: FROM python:3.12-slim -> FROM python:3.11-slim (numpy 1.24.4 ships cp311 wheels).
